prompt: Image 1 is a clay sculpt of a muscular orc, photographed by a camera hovering directly above the top of its head and looking straight down at the ground: a plan view, like a miniature seen from above on a tabletop battle map. The figure stands upright with both arms stretched straight out to the sides. The egg-shaped dome in the centre is the top of its bald skull: the whole dome, from its upper edge to its lower edge, is one unbroken smooth scalp, with the crown and a single soft highlight at its centre. The brow ridge is the narrow shadowed rim along the lower edge of the dome; just beyond that rim sit a small nose-tip bump and two ivory tusk points, and these three tiny shapes are all of the face that the overhead camera reaches. The pointed ears stick out sideways from the dome. The wide horizontal band is the tops of the shoulders, the trapezius and the upper back; the bars to the left and right are the arms seen from above, ending in flat hands with the backs of the hands and knuckles facing the camera. The rounded shelf below the shoulder band is the top surface of the chest and belly seen from above, and the two small bumps at the bottom are the toe tips. Paint this exact sculpt as a finished game character: an orc with olive-green skin, bald scalp, pointed ears, heavy muscles and ivory tusk tips. Keep the identical outline, pose, proportions, position, scale and straight-down viewpoint, tracing the silhouette precisely and keeping every shape exactly where the sculpt has it. Paint the dome as a smooth bald green scalp filling the entire egg shape. Paint the shoulder band as trapezius, deltoid and shoulder-blade muscles seen from above. Hand-painted semi-realistic game-art style with soft shading and a soft dark outline, lit evenly from directly above, on the same flat uniform mid-grey background. Bare unclothed base body, left-right symmetric. Image 2 is a small close-up swatch of this orc's painted skin, for colour and finish only: match its fresh saturated olive-green hue, its lighter yellow-green highlights, its smooth cel-like painted shading with clean muscle-separation lines, and its crisp dark green outline, across the whole figure. The nose tip and the two tusk points rest directly against the chest surface, and smooth chest skin continues immediately beyond them. The two toe-tip bumps keep exactly the small size and position they have in the sculpt, each painted as a row of short toe ends with toenails.
